scope: Default production compiled indexed completion: direct count/range guards for empty remaining passes; removal of old stride-24 pointer-distance iterator bookkeeping. Not speed acceptance or full arithmetic equivalence.
normalization: Exclude int3 padding; normalize RIP-relative displacements, internal direct branches to function-relative offsets, external direct branches/calls to demangled symbol names. All other instructions/operands must match. This does not compare relocated constant contents or absolute function placement.
N210_condition: Known constructor geometry has column/row pass counts 1/1. Both stored counts compare directly against 2; empty remaining ranges skip completion. This review does not execute a constructor or FFT.
F32_scope: Both full normalized symbols match the reviewed indexed diagnostic; direct count/index behavior is preserved, and all 14 old pointer-distance skip patterns disappear independently versus the old default in each variant.
caveats: F64x8 explicit frame grows 112 bytes, F32x8v 64 bytes, F32x16 128 bytes versus prior default; reduced code spans are not a speed proof.
Ordinary radix arithmetic MOVABS/MUL/IMUL remains; the narrow removed pattern is pointer-distance count reconstruction for skip(1).
Descriptor index-times-24 address formation remains correctly; it is not the removed iterator divide.
Register allocation, stack slots, branch placement and executable layout differ from prior default. No causal performance claim follows from these checks.
Numeric correctness and quiet timing acceptance are separate gates.
